shared_elements: schematic frontal anthropomorphic or mask-like figure
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both appear to include a highly schematic frontal human- or mask-like figure with circular/oval features set within or on the body. The biggest difference is that B has a clear, bilaterally organized monumental body with head, paired circular chest features, central circle, and curved abdominal bands, while A is much less legible and does not clearly preserve the same specific set or ordering of motifs.
